scope: Automatic price form matching and visit-cache review; no retailer traffic or lib changes.

fixes.issue: A pre-selected catalogue candidate retained eligibility even when the stricter plain-product rule rejected it.
examples: Lite Cooking Cream for Cooking cream
Olive Oil Spray for Olive oil
Toasted Sesame Oil Blend for Toasted sesame oil
fixes.change: Demote wrong food forms within the scoped plain rules, while retaining explicit manual food-alternative review.

fixes.issue: An adversarial Mushroom Compost/Garden/25kg catalogue fixture was treated as Mushrooms.
fixes.change: Obvious non-food products are ineligible and not reviewable.

fixes.issue: An earlier automatic lookup could overwrite a later reviewed product choice or explicit exclusion.
fixes.change: Bounded per-context revision guard; automatic cache writes require unchanged revision, independent of timestamp ties.

fixes.issue: Malformed stored country could throw during cache-key construction.
fixes.change: Invalid country is an isolated unknown key; stored-location normalization is handled separately by root.

checks.volumeBoundary: 1Australian tbsp=20ml and1tsp=5ml; two15ml packs vs one, no mass-density assumptions

review.automaticEffects: No new render-loop defect found in keyed/debounced effects; obsolete contexts are revision/abort isolated.
review.privacy: Only shopping needs and area context go to same-site price API; retailer queries contain ingredient names; no new personal data persistence introduced.
limitations: Mock catalogue fixtures establish deterministic matching behavior, not actual retailer stock/prices.
Packet dietary labels and shelf availability remain unverified and must retain existing UI labels.
